decisions.statement: Every empty directory under the repos folder is taken away.
A directory under a git folder or under a node_modules folder is passed over.
A pages folder one level under a repository is passed over.
A repository's index is passed over, holding nothing being how an index reads.
Taking a directory away may empty the directory above.
The sweep runs again until nothing goes.
The sweep runs twenty times at most however many directories are left.
A directory that will not go is passed over rather than failing the run.
The repos folder is named by the environment or taken to be the one under home.
How many directories went is said on one line.

definition: the empty directories under the repos folder taken away
